verified_discovery_metadata.note: Provider page also distinguishes labels such as Mundari-Mix. Title/language labels are discovery metadata only; no linguistic or cultural proposition is inferred from them.

canonicalization.rule: Treat the CIET Barkhaa page and its linked Mundari audio objects as manifestations/components of the Barkhaa educational resource unless item-level provenance proves a distinct work identity. Do not count repeated language links, mirrors, cached copies, or mixed-language variants as independent corroborating sources.

required_before_promotion: resolve each provider-linked Mundari audio object and stable item identifier/URL
record SHA-256 for permitted immutable bytes
record exact audio time span and corresponding transcript/page locator where available
verify language/variant label and whether item is Mundari versus Mundari-Mix
trace adaptation/translation dependency on Barkhaa source text

review cultural-access sensitivity before any cultural assertion

promotion.reason: The provider page verifies discoverability and language-labelled manifestations but does not by itself establish item-level reuse, immutable audio bytes, transcript concordance, consent, cultural permission, or exact proposition-supporting locators.

release_gap: Resolve item-level Barkhaa Mundari audio rights, bytes, hashes, transcript/alignment, provenance and consent; retain unresolved objects as explicit gaps.
evidence_policy: Never infer cultural claims from educational story titles, catalogue labels, or public availability.
